notes: «كلاهما عن حماد بن زيد» joins Yahya and Qutayba in one level; «قال يحيى أخبرنا حماد بن زيد» re-opens Yahya's own route, a second group for the same saying
the names after the second route are written once and so belong to both routes (shared tail)
Qabisa speaks in the story («قال تحملت حمالة») and is the last link
